data.one_liner: Show PDF files or bytes as a Flutter widget on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Displays PDF documents from a file path or raw bytes within a widget. Provides a controller to navigate pages, adjust zoom, and handle gestures.
use_when: You need to display PDF files or bytes directly inside a Flutter widget on Android or iOS.
You require interactive features like swiping, zooming, page jumping, and callbacks for page changes or rendering.
avoid_when: You are targeting web or desktop platforms, as this package is restricted to Android and iOS.
You need advanced PDF generation or modification capabilities.
strengths: Supports loading PDFs from both file paths and byte arrays.
Includes a controller for programmatic navigation and zoom management.
Platform-specific implementations handle native rendering efficiently on Android and iOS.
weaknesses: Only supports Android and iOS platforms.
Android setup requires manually adding the JitPack repository.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding JitPack to your Android Gradle repositories in android/build.gradle.
